notes: Rule wording is preserved in substance; Discord asset links were removed and formatting was normalized.
The later Chiefs quit/onside-kick amendment is kept as a separate rule until commissioners decide how it should be merged.

Commissioner clarification: quitting and onside kicks are prohibited at all times; a regular-season illegal onside kick forfeits a draft pick to the opponent at commissioner discretion; quitting or an onside kick in the playoffs justifies removal.

rules.title: League Settings
rules.content:
✅ 48-hour advance cycles for User vs User games
✅ 24-hour response once game channel is created
✅ Stay active — play games or communicate
✅ Respect all league members and commissioners
✅ All-Madden difficulty
✅ 7-minute quarters
✅ 5 playcall limit / 5 play cooldown

📌 Advance times are targeted, not guaranteed to the minute.

rules.title: Core Rules
rules.content:
❌ No quitting or conceding User vs User games at any time.
❌ No onside kicks at any time.
❌ No cheesing or abusive gameplay.
❌ No toxic behavior, harassment, or escalation.
❌ Inactive for 3+ games may result in removal.
❌ No public disputes, accusations, or profanity in lobby-talk.

**QUITTING / ONSIDE-KICK PENALTIES**
• During the regular season, an illegal onside kick will result in the offending team forfeiting a draft pick to the opponent. Commissioners decide which pick is forfeited.
• In the playoffs, quitting or attempting an onside kick justifies removal from the league.

➡️ Lobby-talk is a shared space and is moderated.
➡️ Game channels may be more casual, but lobby-talk must remain respectful.
➡️ Repeated issues may result in moderation or restricted chat access.

➿ For rule clarification, contact a Commissioner.

rules.title: Gameplay Rules
rules.content:
**4TH DOWN RULE**
▪️ 1st Half: You may ONLY go for it on 4th & 1 or shorter.
▪️ 2nd Half: You may go for it on any 4th down.

**CATCH / DEFENDER CONTACT RULE**
❌ No bumping defenders while trying to make a catch.

**NO-HUDDLE RULE**
❌ No excessive no-huddle in the 1st half, unless you are down by 17+ points.

rules.title: Team Ownership & Position Changes
rules.content:
**TEAM OWNERSHIP**
🏈 Once a team is selected, you own that team for 3 seasons before becoming eligible to switch.

**ALLOWED POSITION CHANGES**
Allowed:
✅ Safety ↔ Cornerback
✅ OLB ↔ Defensive End
✅ Offensive Line ↔ Offensive Line
✅ Fullback ↔ Tight End

Not Allowed:
❌ WR ↔ TE
❌ RB ↔ WR, except Madden Deebo packages
❌ Safety/CB ↔ Linebacker
❌ Changing QB throwing hand or style

📌 Sub-packages or animations do not count as position changes.

rules.title: Draft & Transactions
rules.content:
❌ Max 3 first-round picks per draft
❌ Max 12 total picks per draft
❌ Max contract length: 5 years
➡️ Example: If 1 year remains, you may extend 4 additional years.
❌ Rookies cannot be traded.

**Preseason Free Agency Limit**
• During preseason, each team may sign ONE free agent per advance.
• Once the regular season begins, free agency is unrestricted.

**No Trade Backs**
❌ Players traded away cannot be traded back to the same team during that season.

**No Transaction Manipulation**
Users may not manipulate roster mechanics through actions such as:
• Dropping valuable players for another user to sign
• Multi-step trades designed to bypass trade fairness
• Trading a player away with the intention of reacquiring them later

📌 Any attempt to bypass roster rules may result in player reversal, restricted roster control, or removal from the league.
📌 Transactions are monitored by Commissioners and league staff to ensure rule compliance.

rules.title: CPU Games & Auto-Pilot
rules.content:
**CPU GAMES**
• If a CPU game is started, it must be completed.
• A started CPU game that is not completed before advance = FL, unless prior Commissioner approval is granted before advance.
• CPU disconnects require resume-screen proof or may result in an FL.
• Intentionally exiting a CPU game to avoid a loss may result in disciplinary action.
• For User vs CPU teams (Play, FS, or FW), users are responsible for notifying a Commissioner if they want a FW.
• If no Commissioner is notified before advance, Commissioners will assume the user chose to play the CPU.
• This rule is meant to keep advances moving and prevent Commissioners from having to chase users for decisions.

**WHEN A USER IS ON APPROVED AP**
First 3 advances:
• Opponent may play CPU or take FS
• ❌ No FW

After 3 advances:
• Opponent may play CPU
• Or request a FW with Commissioner approval

**LONG-TERM AP TRACKING**
AP is tracked per user, not per session.
• Returning for a single game does not reset AP status.
• User must return and be active for 2 full advances to reset AP status.

📌 If a user repeatedly goes on AP to avoid games or FWs, Commissioners may:
• Remove team control
• Assign permanent CPU
• Remove user from league

rules.title: Disconnects & Connection Requirements
rules.content:
**DISCONNECT POLICY — 1ST HALF DROPS**
If a game drops in the 1st half, the game will be restarted/continued with the same score from the dropped game.
📌 Users should communicate the score, quarter, and situation in the game channel when possible.

**2ND HALF DROPS**
If a game drops in the 2nd half, Commissioners may decide the result based on:
• Current score
• Quarter/time remaining
• Game situation
• History of connection issues
• Available proof or stream/video
📌 Commissioner discretion applies in all disconnect situations.

**CONNECTION REQUIREMENTS**
• All users must have a stable internet connection.
• WiFi is allowed, but ethernet is recommended.
• Users are responsible for their connection quality.
⚠️ Repeated connection issues may result in restricted team control or AP status until resolved.

**NO EXPLOITATION / NO ASSUMPTIONS**
• Intentionally disconnecting to avoid a loss is against league rules.
• Desyncs alone will not be used as proof of cheating or tampering.
• The league will not assume intent based on when or how a disconnect occurs.
📌 Claims of exploitation must be supported by:
• Clear video evidence and/or
• A consistent pattern of repeated issues
📌 Single incidents or assumptions will not determine intent.

rules.title: Streaming & Connection Monitoring
rules.content:
**WIFI WATCH MONITORING, IF NEEDED**
Users with repeated connection issues may be asked to stream or record games.

If streaming is required:
➡️ Twitch VOD storage must be enabled so games can be reviewed after completion.
➡️ Live viewing is not required.
➡️ Review will be handled in a commissioner-managed channel.
➡️ Users will be added case-by-case only. No public watch lists.
📌 If a game disconnects or desyncs while a user is under connection monitoring, Commissioner discretion applies.

**STREAMING**
🎥 Streaming is mandatory in PLAYOFFS ONLY.
📶 Users are expected to have a stable connection capable of streaming.
➡️ Recommended upload speed: 10 Mbps or higher for a reliable stream.
📌 If a user cannot provide a stable playoff stream, Commissioners may require recording, Twitch VOD, or another form of proof if needed.

rules.title: Game Scheduling & Commitments
rules.content:
**GAME CHANNEL COMMUNICATION RULE**
Users are expected to schedule and communicate early after advance.
If a user does not respond in the game channel for 24 hours, a reminder may be sent.

➡️ If one user communicates and the other does not: After the full 24-hour silence period, the active user may:
• Play the CPU/AP
• Or request the FW
➡️ If the active user does not notify a Commissioner of their decision, the game defaults to FS.
➡️ If the inactive user responds before a FW is claimed or CPU game is started, the game is back on.
➡️ If both users do not communicate, the game will be FS at advance.
➡️ Once a FW is claimed or CPU game is started, the decision is final.
📅 Scheduling a game is a commitment, not a suggestion.

**CONFIRMED COMMITMENT**
A confirmed commitment requires a specific date and time to be proposed and clearly accepted.
Examples:
• “Yes”
• “Ok”
• “Confirmed”
• “That works”
If one user is ready at the agreed time and the opponent does not respond within 15 minutes, the waiting user may request a FW, subject to Commissioner verification.

**TENTATIVE COMMITMENT**
Uncertain responses include:
• “Probably”
• “Should work”
• “I’ll try”
Good-faith effort is required. Users must notify their opponent if plans change. No-show without notice may result in a FW at Commissioner discretion.

**NOT A COMMITMENT**
Vague availability does not count as a confirmed game time.
Examples:
• “Later”
• “After work”
• “Sometime today”
📌 Availability windows alone do not qualify for FW eligibility.
📌 A specific start time must be clearly accepted in the game channel to qualify as a confirmed commitment.
📌 FWs are final and will not be reversed by later availability.

**MUTUAL SCHEDULING CONFLICT**
If both users communicate in good faith but cannot align schedules before advance, the game will be Force Sim.
• No user will be penalized.
• This applies only when both parties are responsive.
• Commissioner discretion applies.

rules.title: Advance Timing & Extra-Day Policy
rules.content:
League advances are targeted around ~5:00 PM AZ.
• A short delay past the target time is acceptable.
• Games starting multiple hours after the target advance time risk delaying the league.
• Starting late is done at the users’ risk.

**EXTRA-DAY ADJUSTMENT**
If the final game of a cycle finishes very late, such as 9–11 PM AZ, the league may advance the following morning so all users receive an extra day before the next advance.
📌 This prevents lost preparation time for the league and keeps advance cycles fair.

rules.title: Trading Rules
rules.content:
🔒 All trades require Commissioner approval.

**P2P Trades**
• Users agree
• Submit to Commissioner for approval

**OTB Trades**
• Player must be on the trade block
• CPU teams require screenshot and approval
• ❌ No extra CPU players added

rules.title: Commissioner Protection & Finality
rules.content:
Commissioners may take immediate protective action during disputes, disconnects, or exits, including:
• Removing user team control
• Assigning team to CPU
• Restricting trades or roster moves
• Reverting roster changes

📌 Auto-Pilot may be used but is not relied on alone.
📌 All Commissioner rulings are final. No negotiations after a ruling has been made.

Refusal to comply, repeated arguing after a final ruling, or disrespect toward Commissioners may result in FWs, FLs, restricted control, removal from team control, or removal from the league.

🏈 Play fair. Stay active. Respect the league. 🏈

rules.title: Quit / Onside-Kick Amendment
rules.content:
NEW RULE AMEND

PLAYERS WHO; Quit & On side kick will forfeit a draft pick to their opponent (commish discretion as to what pick). If its in the playoffs, removal.
